messages:
Sam (PM): flagging support ticket about HTTP/2 streaming + function-calling. Need triage.
Elena (Support): ticket #5482 from Acme Corp: "We need partial responses streamed to client while function hooks may trigger mid-response. Current behavior buffers until function call completes, causing 3-5s delay. Customer wants token-level chunks + function call events." Logs attached.
Kai (Eng): are they using websockets or HTTP streaming? paste SDK logs?
Elena (Support): HTTP/2 streaming via hosted API. Logs:
```
REQ id=abc123 path=/v1/chat/stream stream open
... tokens streamed 0..45
func_call:start at token 46
server buffered func_call until completion
delay 3100ms
```
Jules (Sales): Acme is in POC, asking for GA next quarter. If not supported they'll consider alternatives. High commercial impact.
Sam (PM): is this a bug or a missing feature (event model)?
Kai (Eng): runtime currently pauses at function_call token; pause can look like buffer. Options: A) emit func_call event immediately and continue streaming nearby tokens (spec change), B) reduce internal buffering so resume faster (runtime perf), C) document pause and add SDK helpers. Tradeoffs.
Chris (Infra): B might be quickest but could regress throughput.
Sam (PM): acceptance criteria: 1) func_call event within 200ms of model intent detection, 2) tokens before/after event stream without gaps, 3) no >5% p95 regression for non-func-call workloads.
Kai (Eng): estimates: A=4-6wks, B=2-3wks, C=1wk. A has API compatibility risk.
Jules (Sales): Acme wants something in 6 weeks. Prefer A but will accept B with roadmap commitment.
Elena (Support): customer also requests structured output examples and schema enforcement hook for final data.
Sam (PM): propose short-term: B + SDK helper + docs to unblock Acme, then A (event model + schema enforcement) in Q2. Console needs small UX to surface func_call events.
Kai (Eng): ok to sequence. I'll open two PRDs: SHORTTERM-123 (runtime tweak + SDK helper) and MEDIUM-456 (event model + schema enforcement).
Sam (PM): add KPIs to PRDs: func_call latency, token continuity, p95 overall, e2e POC test with Acme.
Chris (Infra): suggest canary rollout and per-tenant toggle so Acme can opt-in.
Sam (PM): next steps: Elena confirm Acme will opt-in; Kai draft PRDs by EOD Thu; Chris to outline rollout. I'll add linked backlog issues.
Elena (Support): confirming with customer now :thumbsup: 
Jules (Sales): noted; sales will manage expectations.
triage-bot: ticket #5482 labeled customer-impact/high, requires-product-review
Sam (PM): keeping this thread as single source of truth. If Acme opts in, start canary schedule.
